snapshot.name: comando_quatro.z80
snapshot.note: Comando Quatro (1989)(Zigurat)(ES).z80, the 48K beeper game; Spanish menu, no English release in the archive.

recordings.name: comando_quatro_loading.scr
recordings.role: The 6,912-byte loading screen from the plain .tap of the same release, staged beside the snapshot; game data, never in this repo; not a recording.

recordings.name: a1.rzx
recordings.role: Scripted keyboard play from the title: menu, the first rooms, a wipe between zones; 9,024 frames. The broken builds and the ABI cases use its first 5,000 frames.

recordings.name: a2.rzx
recordings.role: Scripted keyboard play through all four commandos' zones, deaths, game over and a new game; 45,046 frames, replayed to frame 22,000 (STOPS), as in the review run.

recordings.name: a3.rzx
recordings.role: Scripted keyboard play over the four zones, another seed; 20,054 frames.

verify.note: At every hook every register with R and all 48K RAM except the attribute cells the copy shows (checked against the clean copy, and that copy against the game's own restore) and 32 bytes of dead stack; the Layer 2 picture against an independent model at every publication and wipe copy, and every lit pixel against the bitmap the copy wrote; ABI cases on a1's states and 12 broken builds. Pace, soak, flicker, beam audit and the real loader are in games/comando_quatro.md "Evidence".

status.title: Comando Quatro
status.build: v1.0; comando_quatro_sprites_loading.nex 66563d3e equals the published .nxc 1.0 bare build (without the screen ffcd877f); clash removed: the original bitmap on the ULA, scenery in its own attributes from a clean copy, figures' ink on a double-buffered Layer 2 in plot order; the Kempston port operand at B253 changed from 0xDF to 0x1F, the Next's port; top bank 47, fits a 1MB Next
status.software: 3 recordings, 51,078 frames (a2 to frame 22,000), 82,842 hooks with R and 48K RAM, 9,638 restores against the clean copy, 9,688 Layer 2 pictures and 4,524,667 pixels against the model and the bitmap; 640 ABI cases, 12 of 12 broken builds; ROM paths complete over all of a1, a2 and a3 (Next ROM 8c34d957); review run: pace in JNext in lockstep over the four zones, whole runs -0.47% to -0.27%, slowest 20 updates up to +1.09%; 15-minute soak, flicker, beam audit, real loader on private cards with each cheat
status.next: hardware checklist; the owner's play; Kempston on a real Next (0x1F); Enhanced (no source, rated MODERATE); later rooms and zones

results.scope: runs/comando_quatro/release-20261108: pace, soak, flicker, beam audit and real loader, JNext 1.1.104, on this engine's bytes. Not a selftest stamp.
